verdict.rationale: Entra ID supports background automation via Lifecycle Workflows that 'run automatically against users' through lifecycle phases, and automatic user/group provisioning via SCIM to SaaS apps — these are autonomous, scheduled/background automations, and the Graph API enables programmatic (agent-driven) automation setup. However, none of this is framed as AI-agent-specific tooling (no agent scheduling, no AI-triggered workflow evidence). Missing for 10: explicit AI-agent-oriented automation/orchestration features, evidence of agents autonomously configuring these workflows, and independent corroboration of reliability of these automations running unattended.
